extracted.intended_audience: investment management firms seeking partnership with CZI and early-career investment professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and expectations from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative about how they manage their endowment, the type of investment manager partners they seek, and hiring/recruiting signals for early-career candidates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manager of managers approach
rubrics_metrics.description: We employ a manager of managers approach to partner with best-in-class investment firms globally across asset classes to enable long-term impact for generations to come.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CZI’s investments program is structured to allocate capital to external managers rather than manage all strategies in-house; emphasis on partnering with top-tier firms globally and across asset classes to support long-term giving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment philosophy — fundamental, bottom-up investing with long-term orientation
rubrics_metrics.description: We are fundamental, bottom-up investors with a long-term orientation and we pursue a manager of managers approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CZI favors investment processes that originate from fundamental, security- or company-level research and that take a multi-year view rather than short-term trading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner selection — fundamental research-driven strategies delivering outstanding risk-adjusted returns
rubrics_metrics.description: We seek to partner with exceptional investment firms that pursue fundamental research-driven strategies to deliver outstanding risk-adjusted returns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority given to firms whose strategies are driven by rigorous fundamental research and which have demonstrated the ability to produce strong risk-adjusted performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-market / multi-asset expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Our partners have various areas of expertise across both public and private markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CZI values partner firms that bring specialized knowledge across different asset classes and market types (public equities, private investments, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission requirement — include background materials in PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: If you represent an investment management firm that you think might be a good partner for CZI, please contact us at investmentmanagers@chanzuckerberg.com and include background materials on your firm and strategy in pdf format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reaching out, send a concise PDF with firm background and strategy; use the provided email address for initial contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early-career program — hands-on learning and active portfolio role
rubrics_metrics.description: CZI’s investments program offers the unique opportunity for early-career professionals to learn the craft of investing and to play an active role in managing CZI’s portfolio as part of a collegial and highly collaborative team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Role expectations include active portfolio involvement and collaborative work; this is emphasized as a learning opportunity for early-career hires.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruiting cadence — active early-career recruitment each fall
rubrics_metrics.description: CZI is always looking for talented, driven individuals to join the investments team and actively recruits for early-career roles each fall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should monitor openings in the fall; page includes a 'View Openings' prompt and link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to fair treatment and equal access to opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to fair treatment and equal access to opportunity for all CZI team members, and to maintaining a workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CZI states an organizational expectation of inclusive workplace practices and non-discriminatory treatment for employees and applicants.
